accepted_findings: The 486 candidate files are reproducibly named by repository, pinned revision, tree path, file path, LFS SHA-256, and recorded byte size.
Independent recomputation matches counts 205/135/146, total 1599407518909 bytes, manifest hashes, uniqueness, and zero pairwise whole-file LFS overlap.
Whole-file identity does not establish row-level decontamination, matched language budgets, a selected training set, or tokenizer validity.
The artifacts retain one size field rather than independent API file-size and LFS-size fields; future retrieval must preserve both if equality is claimed.
required_before_sampling: Freeze deterministic row identity, hash ranking, ties, duplicate/missing IDs, traversal, and replacement policy.
Freeze matched per-language row/document and information budgets plus truncation and filtering.
Create a selected-row manifest with source shard identity, stable row ID, content hash, rank, and exclusion reason.
Freeze and execute result-blind GlobalVoices URL/domain and exact/near-text decontamination.
Freeze normalization, pre-tokenization, malformed-row handling, tokenizer arms, merge budget, seeds, cost, and fairness metrics.
claim_boundary: Source-file identity subgate only; no payload, selected corpus, tokenizer training, fairness comparison, confirmation result, or original-paper reproduction.
